subject: Request: Scoped control demonstration & evidence package for Lyricom SOC 2 / ISO alignment
messages:
From: Alex Patel <alex.patel@lyricom.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lyricom.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Lyricom: SOC 2 / ISO evidence & live demo request

Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Lyricom is moving this RFP to the final assurance review and we need two things from Redwood to close the security gate: a scoped control mapping (SOC 2 + ISO 27001 controls that are in-scope for our integration) and a short live demonstration showing how a subset of controls are enforced (focused on encryption-at-rest, access provisioning/audit trails, and key management).

Our timeline is tight: procurement needs the evidence bundle and demo by Sep 25 so internal approvals can proceed. Can Redwood provide: 
- A concise control mapping workbook that lists Redwood controls mapped to Lyricom's required control IDs (we'll attach the required control list)
- A downloadable evidence bundle of representative artifacts (policy excerpts, config snapshots, helm/k8s snippets, sample audit logs) with redaction guidance
- A 30-45 minute demo slot next week (we're US west coast) that includes a short live walk-through and a Q&A with our security lead.

Please confirm scope and earliest availability. I attached the RFP security addendum (Lyricom-RFP-SIG.pdf) that shows the mandatory controls.

Appreciate your help — this is the final gating item for our procurement.

Best,
Alex Patel
Security Program Manager, Lyricom
Procurement cadence: procurement@lyricom.com

Attachments (referenced): Lyricom-RFP-SIG.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Patel <alex.patel@lyricom.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lyricom: SOC 2 / ISO evidence & live demo request

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for attaching the addendum. We can absolutely support this. Proposed approach: 

1) Scope call / confirmation (15–20 min): confirm which data classes and integrations are in-scope so we limit the mapping to relevant controls.
2) Deliverable 1: Control mapping workbook (SOC 2 + ISO 27001 columns, control owner, evidence pointer, sample artifact names).
3) Deliverable 2: Evidence package (zipped folder with redacted artifacts and a manifest).
4) Live demo (30–45 min): brief architecture overview + live demo showing encryption-at-rest key rotation proof, privileged access audit trail, and sample log replay for an audit scenario.

We can aim to deliver the control workbook within 48 hours of the scope confirmation and the evidence bundle within 5 business days. Demo slots we have available (PST): Sep 18 10:00–10:45, Sep 19 13:00–13:45, Sep 20 09:00–09:45. Which works for your team?

I'm looping in Mina (security assurance lead) and Irene (systems engineering) to coordinate artifacts and the demo build. Quick ask for you: please confirm the specific control IDs from your addendum that must be demonstrated live vs. those that can be satisfied by artifact delivery. That helps us prioritize the demo prep.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment intent: We'll produce a control mapping workbook named lyricom-scope-matrix.xlsx and a short agenda PDF for the demo (demo-agenda.pdf).

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Sep 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Lyricom: SOC 2 / ISO evidence & live demo request

Marissa / Irene — quick internal notes to prepare the deliverables. Action checklist: 

- Control mapping workbook: I will author the initial crosswalk. Columns: Lyricom control ID, control text, Redwood control mapping, owner, evidence filename(s), evidence sensitivity (redaction needed?).
- Evidence artifacts to collect (candidate list): 
  - SOC2 Type II report excerpt (redacted) / attestation date
  - KMS config snapshot (aws-kms-config-202809)
  - Encryption-at-rest proof: sample S3 kms-encrypted object headers + CMK rotation record
  - Privileged access: sample access request ticket + approval log (redacted usernames)
  - Audit logs: 7-day ingestion of control-related logs (anonymized)
  - Infrastructure: deployment manifest snippets showing network isolation (k8s-ns.yaml), VPC flow summary
  - Policy excerpts: Data protection policy sections & access review SOP

- Irene: can you pull the KMS config snapshot and a short recorded terminal session that demonstrates a key rotation event? If a live demo is complicated we can show the recorded session and then walk through the logs.
- Marissa: I'll draft a redaction guidance note for Lyricom to expedite review.

Labeling guidance: prefix evidence files with CONTROLID_filename.ext (e.g. CC6.1_kms-config.json). Target to have first draft artifacts in the shared folder by Sep 18 EOD.

Thanks — Mina
Security Assurance Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Patel <alex.patel@lyricom.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@lyricom.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lyricom: SOC 2 / ISO evidence & live demo request

Alex — thanks, we booked Sep 18 10:00–10:45 PT for the demo and prepared the initial artifacts. See the shared folder and attached agenda. Deliverables attached/posted: 
- lyricom-scope-matrix.xlsx (control mapping workbook)
- demo-agenda.pdf (short agenda + goals)
- redwood-evidence-snapshots.zip (initial redacted artifacts manifest inside)

Meeting link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LyricomSec

Agenda (high level):
1) 5 min – Introductions + scope confirmation
2) 10 min – Architecture & control ownership mapping
3) 15 min – Live demo: KMS rotation proof, access provisioning + audit trail replay
4) 10 min – Artifact review and next steps / handoff

Note on artifacts: Mina has included a short redaction guide in the zip. If you need additional context for any artifact we can provide play-by-play notes in the manifest. We will also upload a single-page SOC 2 extract for legal review if you confirm the redaction levels you prefer.

Looking forward to the demo — please reply to confirm the meeting participants and whether you want the privileged access portion to be live or recorded.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: lyricom-scope-matrix.xlsx; demo-agenda.pdf; redwood-evidence-snapshots.zip

From: Alex Patel <alex.patel@lyricom.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lyricom.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lyricom: SOC 2 / ISO evidence & live demo request

Marissa — confirming the Sep 18 10:00 PT slot and thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from our security lead before the demo: 

- We prefer the privileged access segment to be a live demo if possible (we want to see the approval flow and audit trail end-to-end). If live is not feasible, recorded + log replay is acceptable but flag that up front.
- Please include the single-page SOC 2 extract in the evidence bundle (redaction level: redact personal data and internal email addresses, keep control descriptions and dates).
- Procurement: we'll accept the artifact zip for now; legal will request the full SOC 2 Type II under NDA if required in the final contract.

Participants confirmed from Lyricom: Alex Patel (security), Maya Lin (security lead), Procurement contact: procurement@lyricom.com. See you on the call.

Thanks,
Alex
Security Program Manager, Lyricom
